protocol.description: ve(3,3) AMM DEX on Base, with two codebases: Aerodrome Pools (Velodrome v2 / Solidly fork) and Aerodrome Slipstream (Uniswap v3 fork concentrated liquidity). Native AERO token; veAERO governance allocates emissions to gauges weekly via Voter contract. Operated by the Velodrome team. No timelock; team multisig + emergency council administer. Base-native, no bridge surface.
